question: In a certain code language, 'WOLVERINE' is written as 'ZIOPHLLHH'. How will 'LOGAN' be written as in that code language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 

The pattern followed in the given code is:

** Alphabets at odd places are increased by 3 positional values.

 Alphabets at even places are decreased to 6 positional values.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e024b5c62f71236ad718b25aee7c1f5ba196450aad5d5cfe94c050fd1cad1a9.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ca0944e2904606bca48a25e07b74950a7842fe37ec4bb1b98b34c6f1b158b.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 1)**
